	p.EMPLID as EMPLID, 
	p.EMPL_RCD as EMPL_RCD, 
	p.EFFDT as EFFDT, 
	p.EFFSEQ as EFFSEQ

	PS_GVT_PERS_DATA p, NWK_NEW_EHRP_ACTIONS_TBL n

    p.EMPL_RCD = n.EMPL_RCD and
   p.EFFDT = n.EFFDT and
   p.EFFSEQ = n.EFFSEQ
